content: You need to find a way to steal the BF Bandito in Grand Theft Auto 6 to help out Moses. After completing the first batch of requests, Moses will contact you about other cars he wants you to retrieve for him. Among them is this off-road beast. Unlike the Declasse Vamos, you won't need to figure out how to move the BF Bandito out of a garage. The challenge this time is to actually make the target stop.
